confval-stdwrap-parsefunc.name: parseFunc
confval-stdwrap-parsefunc.summary: Processing instructions to be applied to content.

confval-page-includejs.name: includeJS.[array]
confval-page-includejs.summary: Inserts one or more (Java)Scripts in <script> tags. With Properties of 'config' set to TRUE all files will be moved to the footer. The file definition must be a valid resource data type, otherwise nothing is inserted.

confval-coa-wrap.name: wrap
confval-coa-wrap.summary: Wraps all rendered cObjects. Executed before property stdWrap.

confval-condition-applicationcontext.name: applicationContext
confval-condition-applicationcontext.summary: The current application context as a string. See Application context.

confval-mod-web-list-itemslimitsingletab.name: itemsLimitSingleTable
confval-mod-web-list-itemslimitsingletab.summary: Set the default maximum number of items to show in single table view. The number must be between 0 and 10000. If below or above this range, the nearest valid number will be used.

confval-useroptions-pagetree-doktypestos.name: doktypesToShowInNewPageDragArea
confval-useroptions-pagetree-doktypestos.summary: If set, the node top panel feature can be configured by a comma-separated list. Each number stands for a doktype ID that should be added to the node top panel.

confval-mod-wizards-newcontentelement-wi.name: [group].before
confval-mod-wizards-newcontentelement-wi.summary: Sorts [group] in front of the group given.

confval-cobj-user.name: USER
confval-cobj-user.summary: Calls a PHP function or a method in a class, to incorporate your own data processing or content. The output is cached with the page.

confval-cobj-coa-int.name: COA_INT
confval-cobj-coa-int.summary: Works like COA, but is rendered non-cached, so every content object inside it is rendered non-cached as well.

confval-page.name: PAGE
confval-page.summary: Defines what is rendered in the frontend.

confval-stdwrap.name: stdWrap
confval-stdwrap.summary: Gets, changes, and wraps a value. Many properties of content objects and functions accept stdWrap properties.

confval-typolink.name: typolink
confval-typolink.summary: Wraps the incoming value in a link with an HTML 'a' tag.

confval-function-htmlparser-tags.name: HTMLparser_tags
confval-function-htmlparser-tags.summary: Configures how HTMLparser handles one tag, set in its property tags.[tagname].

confval-htmlparser-tags.name: tags
confval-htmlparser-tags.summary: Either set this property to 0 or 1 to allow or deny the tag. If you enter HTMLparser_tags properties, those will automatically overrule this option, thus it's not needed then.

confval-htmlparser.name: HTMLparser
confval-htmlparser.summary: Cleans up HTML: it keeps, removes, or changes tags and their attributes.

confval-config.name: config
confval-config.summary: Sets options for the rendering and output of the frontend page.

confval-stdwrap-current.name: current
confval-stdwrap-current.summary: Sets the content to the "current" value (see ->split)

confval-cobj-pageview.name: PAGEVIEW
confval-cobj-pageview.summary: Renders a page with a Fluid template, which it finds by naming conventions from the backend layout of the page.

confval-plugin-css-default-style.name: _CSS_DEFAULT_STYLE
confval-plugin-css-default-style.summary: CSS that the plugin adds to the page.
